items.title: Bespoke AI Solutions
items.description: We sit down with you, understand how your business works, and find exactly where AI makes a real difference. No generic products — everything is built for your specific needs.

items.title: Websites & Apps
items.description: Premium websites and apps that load fast, rank on Google, and turn visitors into customers. Custom design, not templates. Ready in days, not months.

items.title: Automation & Chatbots
items.description: Stop doing things manually. We build systems that answer your customers, follow up on leads, manage emails, and run your operations — while you focus on what matters.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.description: Get found by the right people. Targeted ad campaigns, social media management, and content that actually drives business growth — all powered by AI.

items.title: GEO / AEO
items.description: Appear in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Generative Engine Optimization puts your business in front of AI-powered search results.

items.title: Training & Workshops
items.description: Teach your team to use AI tools effectively. Hands-on workshops that turn your people into AI power users — no technical background required.

steps.title: Listen
steps.description: We sit down with you and learn how your business actually runs. No assumptions, no pushing products — just listening.

steps.title: Identify
steps.description: Together, we pinpoint where AI and automation can save you time, money, or both. We pick the highest-impact opportunity to start.

steps.title: Build & Deliver
steps.description: We build the full solution — AI, design, backend, everything. You test it, we refine it, and it goes live. Premium quality, delivered fast.

steps.title: Support & Grow
steps.description: We host it, keep it updated, fix what breaks. Once the first solution is running, we move to the next one. Long-term partnership, not a one-off project.

founder.name: Sebastião Guimarães
founder.description: Engineer turned agency founder. I build every solution personally — the AI, the design, the backend. When you work with SurgeX, you work with me directly. No layers, no miscommunication.

network.label: NETWORK
network.description: For larger projects, I bring in trusted specialists — designers, copywriters, domain experts. Small core, flexible reach.

philosophy.label: PHILOSOPHY
philosophy.text: We believe every business deserves AI that actually works — not a demo, not a proof of concept. Real tools that save real time.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: Most websites go live in 2-5 days. Complex projects with custom AI integrations may take 1-2 weeks. We move fast without cutting corners.

items.question: Do I need to understand AI to work with you?
items.answer: Not at all. We handle the technical side. You tell us what's not working in your business, and we figure out where AI makes a difference.

items.question: What happens after my website goes live?
items.answer: We host it, keep it updated, and fix what breaks. You also get analytics so you can see how it performs. We're a long-term partner, not a one-off vendor.

items.question: Can I update the content myself?
items.answer: Yes. We build sites that are easy to maintain. For more complex changes, we're always available — that's what the monthly support is for.

items.question: What's included in the chatbot service?
items.answer: A custom AI assistant trained on your business — services, hours, pricing, FAQs. It answers customers 24/7 in your brand's voice, captures leads, and works in multiple languages.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside Lisbon?
items.answer: Absolutely. We work 100% online and serve businesses across all of Portugal. The process is the same — we listen, build, and deliver remotely.

items.question: What if I'm not happy with the result?
items.answer: We refine until you are. Every project includes a revision period. We don't consider it done until you're satisfied and the solution is performing.

items.question: Are the prices on your site final?
items.answer: They're starting points. Every business is different, so we build a custom quote after understanding your specific needs. No hidden fees — you'll know the full cost upfront.
